description: Research notes written for data maintainers inside reviewed admissions records: instructions such as "do not carry these amounts forward" and process notes such as "reviewed 2026-10-01" or "no entry year inferred". The API removes the exact clauses listed in clauses from applicant-facing text and the matching translations, then applies rewrites, which restate researcher-voice wording ("the reviewed pages do not establish...") as plain guidance to the applicant. A rewrite is a literal phrase or a regex pattern with a replace text and is kept per language; rewrites run in order. Official university wording and applicant-relevant facts are never listed; kept_clauses records reviewed clauses that sound like notes but are kept.
